mechanism: OnTradeTransaction intercepts ORDER_ADD/DEAL_ADD; IsSymbolAllowed loads SymbolWhitelist.txt and case-insensitively matches; non-listed symbols get pending orders canceled or positions force-closed and logged. Whitelist-only governance, no market-feature measurement.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Example whitelist EURUSD,GBPUSD,XAUUSD; any MT5 chart symbol the enforcer sees; no TF analysis.
why_new_for_mis: Execution-universe discipline chrome only — no regime/vol/liquidity/neural sensing of the market.
quote: If the symbol exists in the whitelist: execution proceeds. If the symbol does not exist in the whitelist: execution is denied automatically.

mechanism: IsTradingAllowed = IsWithinAllowedSessions(now) && !IsNewsBlackout(now); sessions from TradingSessions.txt (HH:MM-HH:MM), news from NewsEvents.csv with pre/post blackout minutes; OnTradeTransaction blocks/cancels/closes outside windows. Calendar/schedule enforcement, not live market measurement.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any symbol under the enforcer; server-time session windows; scheduled economic events with minute buffers.
why_new_for_mis: Time/news permission layer only — discusses liquidity troughs and news vol regimes conceptually but does not sense them from price/volume.
quote: At any moment, trading status must resolve to a single boolean state.... Execution is either allowed or blocked based on session validity and news status.

mechanism: CEquityMonitor tracks peak equity and daily start; GetDrawdownPercent=(peak-equity)/peak*100 and GetDailyLossPercent feed CDrawdownAnalyzer thresholds (default NORMAL≤2%, CAUTION≤5%, RESTRICTED≤7%) into CGovernanceStateEngine states NORMAL→CAUTION→RESTRICTED→LOCKDOWN with hysteresis (stableCount≥3), cooldowns, and recovery only when equity/peak≥recoveryThreshold (default 0.99). Maps account stress into graduated execution regimes.
data_needed: ACCOUNT_EQUITY stream; configurable DD thresholds, lockdown/restricted seconds, recovery threshold; hard max DD and max daily loss.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Account-level (strategy-agnostic); demo uses 20/50 SMA crossover ± optional 200 SMA on chart symbol/_Period; backtest compares governing on vs off.
why_new_for_mis: Account-equity stress as a first-class multi-state regime sensor (not just a hard stop) that can gate or size any strategy without changing its signal logic.
quote: The framework monitors peak equity, drawdown percentage, daily loss percentage, and rapid equity deterioration, then maps these signals into four execution states: NORMAL, CAUTION, RESTRICTED, and LOCKDOWN.

mechanism: CDrawdownAnalyzer::IsRapidCollapse records equity every m_rapidSec (default 10s); if drop ≥ m_rapidPct (default 3%) inside that window, returns true and forces immediate state upgrade (e.g. CAUTION/RESTRICTED→LOCKDOWN) even when static DD% has not yet hit the lockdown threshold.
data_needed: High-frequency ACCOUNT_EQUITY samples; rapidSec and rapidPct parameters.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Account equity over seconds (default 10s / 3%); independent of chart TF; stress mode (lot 0.5, no trend filter) used to provoke collapses in tests.
why_new_for_mis: Short-horizon equity velocity sensor detects flash-crash-like account shocks before slow drawdown % reacts—usable as a change/stress tripwire alongside market vol sensors.
quote: If within that window the equity drops by m_rapidPct% (default 3%), the method returns true – signaling an immediate state upgrade, regardless of the current drawdown percentage.

mechanism: ENUM_SETUP_STATE cycle NO_SETUP→SETUP_FORMING→SETUP_CONFIRMED→SETUP_ACTIVE→SETUP_EXPIRED; FORMING when |fastMA−slowMA|/_Point ≤ formingDistancePoints; ConfirmSetup sets confirmed time + expiry; CanTrade requires confirmed/active, TimeCurrent≤expiry, (TimeCurrent−confirmed)≤freshnessMinutes, session window, and no global lock.
data_needed: Strategy confirmation event + expiry seconds; optional session hours; signalFreshnessMinutes; SMA handles for the example EA.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Example EA: chart _Symbol PERIOD_CURRENT with SMA 20/50; default session 08:00–17:00; freshness 15 min; expiry 1800 s.
why_new_for_mis: Treats opportunity validity as an explicit timed state machine (forming/confirmed/stale/expired)—a reusable temporal sensor of whether a detected setup is still actionable.
quote: A setup is considered tradable only when the following conditions are met: the setup has been confirmed; the setup has not expired; the signal is still fresh; the current time falls within the permitted session; and no global trading lock is active.

mechanism: Fan / Parallelogram / Triangle templates sample closes at fixed offsets over 24 or 48 H1 bars; each input is a rounded point distance (cast to 100-point bins via (int)(a/100)*100) from an anchor or constructed geometry (±800/1200 point offsets). Fed to a weighted perceptron or DeepNeuralNetwork 4-4-3 / 8-4-3 as a compact path-shape vector.
data_needed: iClose series at chosen offsets; Point(); template geometry constants; optimized perceptron/NN weights.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; history depth 24 bars (~1 day) vs 48 bars (~2 days); 4 vs 8 input parameters; SL/TP variants 600/60, 200/230, 200/430; opt 2019-02-18–2022-02-18, forward 2022-02-18–2023-02-18.
why_new_for_mis: Encodes multi-horizon candle-path geometry (fan/parallelogram/triangle) as quantized sequence features for neural sensing, with explicit depth×width ablation rather than raw OHLC dumps.
quote: A template is a kind of construction similar to a "floating pattern". Its values are constantly changing depending on the situation on the market, but each of the values is in a certain range.... the value in the template is rounded up to an integer

mechanism: Preprocess NN/perceptron inputs with Min-Max x_norm=(x−xmin)/(xmax−xmin), Z-score (x−μ)/σ, first difference y'(t)=y(t)−y(t−1), and log10 transform; optional local (window) min-max, spike clip at 2σ→mean, and SMA smoothing. Practice compares raw Accelerator Oscillator on 4 bars vs differentiated AC into a perceptron.
data_needed: Indicator or price series window; min/max or mean/std over that window; optional spike/smooth helpers.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; Accelerator Oscillator on four candles; SL 300 / TP 600; opt 2019-04-06–2022-04-06, forward 2022-04-06–2023-04-06.
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS an explicit feature-conditioning toolkit (scale, center, difference, log) so neural sensors see stationary, bounded series instead of raw indicator levels with uncontrolled range.
quote: Normalization of inputs consists in transforming the input data so that it has a certain range of values. Two main methods of normalization are normalization by mean and standard deviation (z-normalization) and normalization by minimum and maximum (min-max normalization).

mechanism: Perceptron inputs = point distances between EMA(1) and EMA(24) on CLOSE at bars 1,4,7,10 (four features); dual outputs for buy vs sell; weights/structure tuned via genetic optimization (NeuralNets.mqh layers, TANH/SIGMOID, learning rate, momentum).
data_needed: Two MA buffers (periods 1 and 24, MODE_EMA, PRICE_CLOSE); point-normalized gaps at fixed bar offsets; trained weights.
why_new_for_mis: Simple self-contained sequence sensor: lagged MA-gap vector → perceptron direction score usable as a lightweight neural market-direction feature without a deep net.
quote: Pass the distance between the Moving Average indicator with the value of 1 and the Moving Average indicator with the value of 24.... Use the distance on the candles 1, 4, 7, 10 (4 parameters) as inputs.

mechanism: Distance family: (1) level-to-level e.g. (MA1−MA100)/Point, MACD/CCI vs 0; (2) same-series N-bar delta ind[0]−ind[Candles]; (3) delta from last MA cross or last MACD/CCI zero-cross found by backward scan. Signed distances feed the perceptron as overbought/oversold and direction relative to a stable historical anchor.
data_needed: MA, MACD, CCI (and optionally StdDev) buffers; Candles lookback; Point(); last-cross index search up to ~1000 bars.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Examples on chart Symbol()/PERIOD_CURRENT; trading EA EURUSD H1 with MA1 SMA CLOSE, MA200 SMA CLOSE, CCI 42, StdDev 60; Candles=8; SL 400 / TP 830; opt 2021-10-10–2022-10-10, forward +1y.
why_new_for_mis: Replaces raw oscillator/price levels (non-stationary, divergent) with anchored signed distances—portable neural features that stay comparable across time.
quote: Distances – distance of any indicator to another indicator or its zero value.... by using distances, we can determine whether the market has moved far from its average and whether it is considerably overbought or oversold

mechanism: Accumulation = sum of (MA1−MA100) or MACD/CCI values over fixed N candles, or summed from the last cross/zero-cross until now. Small |accumulation| ⇒ consolidation/turbulence; large signed accumulation ⇒ protracted trend in that direction—used as perceptron inputs.
data_needed: Same indicator buffers; Candles window or last-cross breakpoint; running signed sum.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Same MA1/MA100, MACD, CCI examples; EURUSD H1 trading setup as above.
why_new_for_mis: Turns path-integrated indicator mass into an explicit trend-vs-consolidation regime sensor complementary to single-bar distances.
quote: If the accumulation is small, perhaps consolidation is now underway. Conversely, if the accumulation is large, there is a protracted trend. Direction depends on the sign (- or +).

mechanism: Slope proxy = ((ind[0]−ind[Candles])/Point)/Candles (or /bars_since_last_cross); applied to MA1, MA100, MACD, CCI. Positive/negative slope encodes impulse direction; magnitude encodes impulse vs attenuation, scale-independent of chart zoom when expressed per bar in points.
data_needed: Indicator series; Candles or bars-since-cross denominator; Point() for price-based series.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: MA1/MA100/MACD/CCI on PERIOD_CURRENT examples; combinable with distance/accumulation in Combo EA; EURUSD H1 trading context.
why_new_for_mis: Per-bar indicator velocity as an impulse/attenuation change sensor for neural stacks—detects whether activity is accelerating without depending on chart scale.
quote: Slope angles – current slope angle of the indicator is a very good way to inform the neural network about the current impulse movement or its absence and the attenuation of activity on the instrument.
